Text:
[II] God, You strengthen our hope and give us joy every morning as we praise You. For this reason, we pray with confidence:
[IR] For the glory of Your Name, hear us, Lord.
[I1] We thank You, God and Father of our Savior Jesus,
[I2] through Him, You gave us knowledge and eternal salvation.
[I1] Grant us humble hearts,
[I2] so we may devote ourselves to one another in joyful imitation of Christ.
[I1] Infuse us with Your Holy Spirit,
[I2] so the love of Your servants will be without pretense or hypocrisy.
[I1] You entrusted the care of creation to us all through our work:
[I2] may our work glorify You, and help sanctify Your children.
Changes: 2024-06-05 - Paul Prins: Initial translation of these intentions
